The split paragraph itself is `deleted` (detail.splitInto) and pooled.

cases.name: edit-one-of-three-writes-one-row
cases.notes: §5.4 step 10 (14.2): the second observation edits one word of the beta paragraph. The matcher sees four verdicts (the outcome counts `same: 3, edited: 1`) but the tables gain exactly one row — `b_2` `edited` under `c_1`; the heading and the two untouched paragraphs keep only their `inserted` rows from `c_0`, so their last change (MAX commit ts over `block_changes`, the surface's `updated_at`) stays at `c_0` and only `b_2`'s moves. Through 14.1 four rows were written, three of them `same`.
